records.subject: A better way to track team projects
records.body:
Hi Victor,

If you haven't had a chance to set up your first project yet, now's a great time -- it's the quickest way to see what Wrenfield is for.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: You're in -- let's get Blue Analytics set up
records.body:
Hi Victor,

Thanks for setting up Blue Analytics on Wrenfield. If your team is more than one person, inviting them now tends to pay off -- Wrenfield is built around teammates working on shared tasks, not solo lists.

Let me know how the first week goes.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.text: New signup alert -- *Blue Analytics* just created a workspace on starter.

decisions.rationale: First project reached day 2 (2026-07-10) but no key milestone and no invite 5 days later; zero inbound customer replies to outreach [email:5a2362d7], [email:c0539e71] despite a held onboarding call [calendar:7d8bfca6]. Starter, solo, 8 days left -- some chance of self-serve progress but momentum looks low.

draft.subject: Next step for Blue Analytics
draft.body:
Hi Victor,

Good to talk on our onboarding call last week, and nice work getting your first project created. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, so adding your real work into that project is usually the fastest way to see where it fits.

If it would help, I'm happy to jump on a short call this week and walk through that first step with you -- just reply with a time that suits and I'll make it work.

Best,
Nadia
